raw_notice_text:
PUBLIC ADVISORY: MUNICIPAL WATER SUPPLY MAINTENANCE
Municipal Corporation of Greater Mumbai
Notice Date: 12 March 2026

Residents of Ward G-North are informed that scheduled pipeline repair works
will be executed on Sunday, 15 March 2026. Water supply will be suspended
between 08:00 AM and 06:00 PM.

Residents are requested to store sufficient water in advance.
